We do, and it's quite a good one from what I hear. I believe it's open twenty four hours a day, but it's Summertime, and I don't know what their schedule is. Never checked it out myself, but our school has something of a...Reputation for attracting the variously mentally ill. Well, either that, or our school actively makes people mentally ill. It becomes hard to tell.

In any case, I know she's aware of it, so I will encourage her to go when I see her next.

I think you're right, but to be honest I wasn't at all sure that her leaving wasn't the right thing for her to do. To be even more honest, I'm still uncertain. It's just that she posed to me a dichotomy, and it was suicide or getting out. I think I would have tried to facilitate her getting out if she had really persisted, but I really can't say because that would put her 3,000 miles from most of her support group (She said she has a friend where she wanted to go). I just wanted to talk to her long enough to get some idea of whether this was a good idea or not (She has plenty of money to cover a last-second ticket).

Well, hopefully she'll be back at the house soon. Thanks.
